name: Three-year IT roadmap
alt: Rising budget bars and a quarterly roadmap
story: Tech spending was one surprise after another. We mapped every device and licence, then built a three-year roadmap and budget the board could approve.

page.timeline: Six weeks to the first roadmap
challenge: A non-profit of 30 people kept getting surprise IT bills: a failed laptop here, a licence renewal there. Each one came out of a program budget.
Their board wanted a number for the year ahead, and nobody could give one.

steps.title: Count everything
steps.detail: Every device, licence and contract, with its age and renewal date.

steps.title: Plan replacements
steps.detail: A schedule that spreads hardware costs evenly across three years.

steps.title: Find savings
steps.detail: Unused licences cut and two contracts moved to non-profit pricing.

steps.title: Present to the board
steps.detail: A one-page budget and a three-year roadmap, explained in plain words.

results: The board approved the IT budget a year ahead.
No surprise IT bills in the first year.
Non-profit pricing and licence clean-up covered most of the new laptops.
